title: SmimeError not Serialize/Deserialize — inconsistent with CertChainError and result types
description: error.rs: SmimeError derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq but NOT Serialize/Deserialize. CertChainError, VerificationResult, and SignerResult all derive Serialize+Deserialize. SmimeError is returned from all public functions and could cross a serialization boundary (e.g. in an IPC protocol or log). Missing Serialize/Deserialize on SmimeError is inconsistent with the documented crate invariant 'All public structs implement Serialize + Deserialize' (from CLAUDE.md). SmimeError contains a Vec<SignerResult> in AllSignersFailed — all its fields are serializable.
close_reason: SmimeError::Der(der::Error) cannot derive Serialize+Deserialize because der::Error does not implement those traits. Fixing it requires changing Der(der::Error) to Der(String), losing the source() chain. The workspace invariant applies to data types (ParsedPart, VerificationResult) not error enums. Opinion.
